narrative.overview: The dark creator storefront, chosen by the user and executed against Reason Studios, Signature Sounds, and BOOM Library as the craft bar. Near-black ground, massive uppercase display type, cover-art-led product cards, category tiles, and one confident violet accent. Confident and commercial; the covers carry the color, the chrome stays neutral.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black neutral ground with raised panels and soft 16px card radii
Inter Tight 800 uppercase display; Inter body; Inter Tight 600 caps labels
One violet accent for live/active/CTA-support; white-fill primary buttons
Cover-art-led cards with honest hover-play demos
Category tiles and featured-pack hero in the reference stores' grammar
One authored motion: card lift + rise-in entrances

rules.name: The One-Accent Rule
rules.body: Violet is the only accent. It marks what is live, active, or chosen — never decoration, never a second color voice.

rules.name: The Cover-Carries-Color Rule
rules.body: Product color lives in the cover art. Chrome stays neutral so the catalog reads like a record-shop wall.

rules.name: The Honest-Playback Rule
rules.body: A card plays only when a real demo exists. Cover-only products show no player and no play badge — the absence is stated, not faked.

rules.name: The Claim-Is-Content Rule
rules.body: Display lines carry product truth, not slogans or eyebrow labels.

dos: Do lead every product surface with its cover art; the artwork is the merchandise.
Do reserve violet for live/active/CTA-support and use white-fill buttons for primary commerce actions.
Do keep hover-play honest: only packs with real demos get the badge and behavior.
Do use tabular numerals for prices, counts, and readouts.
donts: Don't add glow, neon, glass, or gradient text — the references are dark but matte.
Don't introduce a second accent color; violet is the whole voice.
Don't fake players, reviews, or payment — placeholders stay labeled.
Don't use Unicode glyphs as icons — draw inline SVG.
Don't hard-code left/right CSS direction — the Arabic phase requires logical properties.
